elements.evidence: The rendered clause retains a mutual restriction binding Customer: "Neither party shall solicit personnel of the other party directly involved in the Services for 12 months after their involvement ends". A restriction on Customer therefore survives, so the preferred no-non-solicit outcome is not achieved (the proposal targets the fallback).

Both original ("Neither party shall solicit the employees of the other party") and rendered text ("Neither party shall solicit personnel of the other party...") apply symmetrically to both parties; already met and preserved.

elements.element: The restriction covers only personnel directly involved in the Services.
elements.evidence: Rendered text narrows the original "employees of the other party" to "personnel of the other party directly involved in the Services".

elements.element: The restriction lasts no longer than 12 months after the person's involvement ends.
elements.evidence: "for 12 months after their involvement ends" replaces the open-ended "during the Term of this Agreement"; the temporal anchor is the end of involvement, exactly as the element requires (regex check value=12).

elements.element: General advertisements are excluded from the restriction.
elements.evidence: "general advertisements and unsolicited approaches are excluded" — express carve-out in operative language, confirmed by the general-solicitation carve-out check.

elements.element: Unsolicited approaches are excluded from the restriction.
elements.evidence: Same operative sentence expressly excludes "unsolicited approaches".

elements.element: The restriction does not prohibit hiring.
elements.evidence: The only prohibited conduct is to "solicit"; no "employ or engage", "hire", or "induce to leave" language appears anywhere in the rendered clause, and none existed in the original to delete.

reasons: All six fallback elements are met in operative language: mutuality retained, scope narrowed to personnel directly involved in the Services, duration capped at 12 months anchored to the end of involvement, and both carve-outs expressly stated, with no no-hire component. The fallback level is position-complete.
Preferred level is correctly not claimed: a mutual solicitation restriction still binds Customer.

Minimality holds. The edits touch only scope, duration and carve-outs. Replacing "during the Term of this Agreement" was required by the duration element, and dropping "for any reason" was necessary to avoid a retained sentence contradicting the new general-advertisement and unsolicited-approach carve-outs; "employees" to "personnel" is part of the scope element's required wording, not a cosmetic change. No survival tail, expense language, procedure or other extras were added.

Intent is preserved: the clause remains a single mutual solicitation-only covenant in Section 22.14, no cross-reference, defined term or commercial mechanic is left dangling, and no unrelated favourable language was deleted.
Severity remains medium: the original clause (all employees for the whole Term, no carve-outs) was a material fallback failure but not a no-hire or >24-month walk-away term, and the redline cures it.
